project: dev-crew Source App — Self-Judging Workflow Engine
skip_reason: Backend service (localhost:3001) and frontend (localhost:5173) not running at audit time
grade_rationale: 2 confirmed P1s + 1 unconfirmed P1 (DEP-002 pending verification). Config threshold: C = max_p1:2, max_p2:15, min_spec_coverage:40. Active spec coverage 100% exceeds all thresholds. P1 count at boundary of C/D — grade C assigned pending DEP-002 confirmation; if confirmed, re-evaluate for D.

escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution (CVSS 9.8) — Pending Verification
escalations.immediate_action: Run 'npm ls protobufjs' after clean install in platform/orchestrator and portal/Backend to confirm usage

p1_findings.title: GET /api/search Endpoint Not Implemented
p1_findings.description: The GET /api/search endpoint called by DependencyPicker frontend component does not exist. 5 tests in search.test.ts are explicitly marked as failing until implemented.
p1_findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts implementing GET /api/search?q= returning {data: WorkItem[]}, register in app.ts, add // Verifies: FR-dependency-search

p1_findings.title: Handlebars JavaScript/Template Injection — 8 CVEs (max CVSS 9.8)
p1_findings.recommendation: cd Source/Backend && npm update handlebars --depth=999. TheGuardians to review template usage for user-supplied input.

p1_findings.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution (CVSS 9.8) — Unconfirmed
p1_findings.notes: npm ls protobufjs returns empty — may be lock-file orphan. Investigate before dismissing.
p1_findings.recommendation: Run npm ls protobufjs after clean install in both projects. Update to >=7.5.5 if confirmed present.
p1_findings.effort: low to verify, medium if confirmed

p2_findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Only Scans 1 of 8 Plans — False Green Gate
p2_findings.recommendation: Add --all-plans mode OR update CLAUDE.md gate to explicit plan name. See QO-005 for regex fix to bundle with this.

p2_findings.title: Route Handlers Directly Access Store — Architecture Violation
p2_findings.recommendation: Extract workItemService.ts wrapping store CRUD. Route handlers call service, not store directly. Follow dashboardService.ts pattern.

p2_findings.title: Orphaned Spec dev-workflow-platform.md Has 70+ Untraced FRs
p2_findings.recommendation: Add ARCHIVED/SUPERSEDED banner at top, or move to docs/archive/. References workflow-engine.md as replacement.

p2_findings.title: OpenTelemetry SDK Prometheus Exporter DoS (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.recommendation: cd portal/Backend && npm update @opentelemetry/sdk-node. Coordinate with observability team; test metrics endpoint after update.

p2_findings.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS — CPU Exhaustion via Crafted URLs (CVSS 7.5)
p2_findings.recommendation: npm update express path-to-regexp in both projects. Run ReDoS fuzz test after patch.

p2_findings.title: OpenTelemetry Auto-Instrumentations Inherits High Severity
p2_findings.recommendation: Update parent @opentelemetry/sdk-node (same fix as DEP-003) — this resolves DEP-005 transitively.

p3_findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Regex Misses Lowercase FR IDs
p3_findings.recommendation: Change regex from FR-[A-Z0-9-]+ to FR-[A-Za-z0-9-]+

p3_findings.title: Duplicate Frontend Test Files for WorkItemDetailPage and WorkItemListPage
p3_findings.recommendation: Delete root-level duplicates; keep tests/pages/ versions which are more complete.

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable Comments in Production Source (2 occurrences)
p3_findings.recommendation: Replace eslint-disable with useRef stable ref or useMemo for filters object.

p3_findings.title: Express / body-parser / qs Parameter Pollution (Moderate)
p3_findings.recommendation: npm update express qs across all projects.

p3_findings.title: Brace-Expansion Memory Exhaustion DoS (CVSS 6.5)
p3_findings.recommendation: Update to >=1.1.13 in next patch cycle.

p3_findings.title: Vite / Vitest / esbuild Dev Vulnerabilities (Path Traversal, CORS)
p3_findings.recommendation: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vite vitest

p3_findings.title: PostCSS Unescaped CSS Output XSS (CVSS 6.1, dev-time)
ws WebSocket Uninitialized Memory Disclosure (CVSS 4.4)
p3_findings.recommendation: Update ws to >=8.20.1 (transitive — update parent package).

p4_findings.title: 3 Files Approaching 500-Line Split Threshold
p4_findings.recommendation: Extract sub-components and custom hooks in next refactor pass. No immediate action.

p4_findings.title: setup.ts Test Infrastructure File Missing Intentional-Omission Comment
p4_findings.recommendation: Add // Testing infrastructure — no FR traceability required comment.
